product_one_liner.value: Scandit provides vision-AI-powered smart data capture—including barcode, ID and label scanning and store-intelligence tools—for businesses, their workers and their customers.
product_one_liner.notes: Company page describes products and intended beneficiaries.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page offers fixed and flexible pricing and quote-based pricing tiers, although it does not list prices.

named_customers.notes: These are identified as customers on Scandit's customer stories page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201-500 employees.

hq_location.notes: Company page states its global headquarters are in Zurich, Switzerland.

founded_year.notes: Company page states Scandit was founded in 2009.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is predominantly marketing, product and industry content; no two qualifying engineering-authored posts documenting how the product is built were found.

public_docs.notes: Scandit maintains a public developer documentation portal with multiple guides and SDK documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live posting is for Senior Computer Vision/Machine Learning Engineer - Video/Action Recognition.

model_provider.notes: Scandit describes its own Vision AI Engine and AI-powered scanning but does not publicly identify a specific AI model or provider in the product, documentation or security information reviewed.

compliance_certs.notes: Scandit states it is ISO 27001:2022 certified. GDPR is also referenced as a privacy regulation, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: The latest located funding announcement states a $150 million Series D completed in February 2022.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest located funding announcement predates the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page did not expose specific current job listings, so an absence of qualifying sales jobs could not be established.

launched_6mo.notes: Scandit announced Agent Skills for barcode scanning on 2026-06-02, within the six-month period.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The management page lists current leaders but provides no joining dates sufficient to establish or rule out a change in the relevant period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The documentation portal and available careers information reviewed did not name CRM or sales/marketing systems.
